# Impossible Things in Workshop

Source: [wiki article 5900](../archive/5900.md); edited 2025-05-07.

<a id="wiki-5900-n1"></a>

- Archive lists missing direct capabilities: hiding most abilities, duplicating player-owned objects, directly adding effects to abilities, scaling abilities, and directly modifying weapon attack speed.

<a id="wiki-5900-n2"></a>

- It says player-owned objects such as BOB/turrets do not trigger relevant player events; barriers have invisibility/scaling exceptions.
